page.layout: One printed page, index in two columns; the right column is cut off by the scan edge. Running title and heading at top centre. Left column of author entries with page numbers; right column of further entries partly visible at the edge.; Two blocks: the right-hand column of index entries from the top of the scan (Leonides to Lysis), then the letter M and its column of entries down to "Mulieres"; at the bottom left, a short run of entries aligned to the left of the M column.
page.notes: The right-hand column is cut off by the edge of the scan; only its first characters are visible. Some underlining and blue marks over names are digitiser or manuscript marks and are not transcribed. Lines of the second column beyond the scan edge are cut and marked with a partial line. Right-hand column and M column read top to bottom; the bottom-left entries (Laurentius, Leo I.) are placed last because their column's upper part is not on this scan. Several entries are blurred under blue overlay marks; readings such as "Aspilcueta", "Meffalani", "Mifsovitae" and the page numbers 242/244 and 117-122 are doubtful. No page number or running head is visible.
